source.scope: Aerial AC1024 NOD C, owner dictionary 99 and all 27 original VISUALSTYLE records.
source.class: The same successful read publishes encoded class 506 VISUALSTYLE / AcDbVisualStyle / ObjectDBX Classes. Its declaration is joined to each record and checked against the emitted class with a selected instance count of 27.
source.wire: ODA v5.4.1 common framing and dictionary §20.4.44 plus a separate body decoder and the pinned LibreDWG trace. All 28 scalar/companion slots, five CMC fields, detached UTF-16 description, footer and exact owner/reactor terminal positions are checked for each frame. Class frames are 103–149 bytes. The 604-byte owner dictionary has body [0,67), strings [67,4257), footer [4257,4274), common owner/reactor to C, 27 role-2 items and six terminal one bits. No source style has an extension-dictionary handle.
source.anonymousKey: The dictionary key *A1 targets source handle 19A and its description remains *.

transaction.sourceBinding: Recognize the imported 27-member graph before testing physical evidence. Bind the original importer and generation, distinct frame ordinals/locations, class provenance, immutable complete bytes and typed models. The candidate cannot fall back to a typed-only proof.
transaction.staged: Compare the original class, NOD key and child dictionary order, owners/reactors, all remapped dictionary entry roles, and every emitted style field before publishing. The source bytes are checked again at finalization.

validation.wireControls: All 32,656 single-bit corruptions plus 138 targeted truncation, extension, and typed-model/role changes were refused. Restored originals succeeded.
validation.faultRetry: Seven cases per encoding cover staged key, role and description changes, plus early and late raw source-style and dictionary faults. Each refuses at the expected phase, preserves the destination and allows corrected retry with the same codec.
validation.independentReadback: ezdxf 1.4.5 verified selected OBJECTS identities, rooted membership and all 27 ordered key/role pairs; each child has owner/reactor A099, and the map preserves *A1 to A19A with description *. Compared all 28 projected fields and ordered companions and the five color roles against independent peer values. The readback rejected a malformed subclass and a changed NOD key before accepting the unchanged pair again.
validation.releaseInventory: 1319 released files, 742 selected inputs, zero advertised routes.
validation.focused: PASS 13/13. ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R visual_style|visualstyle|tablestyle_(r24_typed_writer|source_proof) --output-on-failure -j 4. Includes AC1021 and non-aerial AC1024 writer profiles, color/source replay, graph and TABLESTYLE controls.
validation.wholeSource: The full original drawing still refuses strict output at the SUN owner mismatch from VIEW 242 through SUN 24C to common parent XRECORD 246, preserving the existing destination.

limits: The ODA DXF generates extension dictionaries for all 27 styles. Its ACI fallback is 8 on five C2 true-color fields for which the selected writer emits 7. The packed RGB and companion values agree; native rendering equivalence remains open.
The helper observes the source wire; the immutable full typed baseline additionally guards model fields with no representation in the observed wire.
The selected transaction does not close strict whole-file export or unrelated root and native GUI qualification.
